shots.scene: Exterior of a modest two-storey Indian house in a small town near Vijayawada at night, lit windows upstairs, a faint street light, the front door closed, quiet and tense, wide shot.

A narrow Indian residential street at night with a CCTV camera mounted on a pole in the foreground, a person in a black cap and mask walking away in the distance seen only from behind, wet road reflecting street lights.
